summary: The spline-trimmed extrude constructor lands as ONE door-callable composition. `binding.rs` gains `TrimExtrudeRow` (profile + recorded closed spline curve + optional algebraic pullback net + tolerance), `TrimExtrudeOutcome` (certified bracket / value / local bbox / certified crossing records / retained-arc count), `trim_extrude` (the composition) and the pyo3 export `binding_trim_extrude`. The composition runs the landed stages IN ORDER and reimplements none of them: (1) local-frame extrude — the profile is projected into its own recorded plane and swept along its normal through the landed `bd_bridge` prism geometry; (2) pullback polynomial — the volume-form pullback is the constant density net `height` over the unit square (an extrusion's Jacobian is constant); (3) R9 crossings — `trim_clip` isolates the certified crossings of the profile's arcs against the closed spline trim loop and stamps them as `TopoNode::TrimCrossing` nodes; (4) winding classification — `trim_clip`'s sound `certify_off_loop` + `winding_number` composition classifies the retained sub-arcs; (5) ADM-003 bracket — `certify_algebraic_trim_bracket` integrates the density over the recorded pullback net and returns the certified two-sided bracket. The no-trim degenerate case is BIT-IDENTICAL to the landed prism arm (the landed `prism_geom` volume is returned unchanged, bracket degenerate). Every class the composition cannot close refuses TYPED naming the `TrimClipFailed` family: a self-crossing control loop (`trim_loop_self_crossing`), a trim with no recorded pullback net (`trim_pullback_missing`), and a control loop above the clip's degree envelope (`trim_degree_out_of_envelope`). The executor gains `SolidSpec::TrimPrism` (a pure pass-through: `solid_volume` / `solid_local_bbox` / `solid_mesh` call the constructor and re-enter the normal facts/mesh path), and the door's `extrude` arm flips a spline-bounded face to the `trim_prism` row (all-line faces keep the exact prism row byte-for-byte) and dispatches it through `bd_facts` at record time so the typed refusal surfaces at the `extrude` site. All four named tests are green; the full truck123d lib+integration suite is green serial.

implementation.binding_rs: New `TrimExtrudeRow { profile: Vec<ProfileEdge>, amount, both, trim_curve: Vec<[f64;3]>, trim_net: Vec<Vec<f64>>, tolerance }`, `TrimCrossingRecord { kind: "trim_crossing", certified, point }`, `TrimExtrudeOutcome { ok, bracket, value, bbox, crossings, retained_arcs }`, `TrimExtrudeFacts { volume, bbox, mesh }`. `trim_extrude` builds the certified graph of the base chart polygon (boundary nodes + straight ordinary arcs over `ArcCert`/`Frame`/`HermiteSpline`, chart `ChartId(0)`), builds the closed rational `BezierLeaf1` of the recorded control loop, runs `trim_clip`, extracts every `TopoNode::TrimCrossing` as a certified record (`NodeCert::Exact`), and calls `certify_algebraic_trim_bracket` over the constant density and the recorded net. `trim_extrude_solid` assembles the executor's facts (value, bbox, deterministic mesh) for the `TrimPrism` row. `binding_trim_extrude` is the pyo3 export; refusal marshaling is total (`marshal_kernel_refusal` names the kind; a missing net / self-crossing / out-of-envelope loop is the typed `trim_clip_failed` case).
implementation.bd_bridge_rs: New `SolidSpec::TrimPrism { profile, amount, both, trim_curve, trim_net, tolerance }` (serde `kind: trim_prism`). `solid_volume`, `solid_local_bbox` and `solid_mesh` dispatch the row to `crate::python::binding::trim_extrude_solid` and map its typed error back to the executor's typed `Refusal`; `solid_carrier_class` classifies it canonical (prism-like). The landed `prism_geom` / `prism_bbox` / `prism_mesh` helpers become `pub(crate)` and `Triangle` is `pub(crate)` so the constructor reuses them (no trim math in the bridge).
implementation.door_py: `extrude(face, amount, both)` splits the face boundary into line edges and spline edges. An all-line boundary records the exact `prism` row (unchanged). A boundary carrying a spline records `{"kind": "trim_prism", "profile": <line edges>, "trim_curve": <closed spline samples>, "trim_net": [], "tolerance": 1e-3}` and dispatches it through `_T123D.bd_facts` at record time. The door's error record now carries the typed exception `payload` when present, so a refusal names its carrier envelope.

tests_required.spline_trim_extrude_volume_matches_recor: pass (binding.rs): a unit-square base trimmed by the recorded closed spline loop with the quarter-disk pullback net (`1 - u^2 - v^2`, degree (2,2)); the certified two-sided bracket contains the recorded reference `height * pi/4`, and the bracket is ordered.
tests_required.trim_crossings_are_certified_nodes_not_c: pass (binding.rs): a base square crossed by a closed trim loop; `trim_extrude` returns non-empty crossing records whose `kind` is `trim_crossing` and whose `certified` flag is true (every crossing is an exact `TopoNode::TrimCrossing`, never a bare coordinate pair).
tests_required.self_crossing_trim_loop_refuses_typed: pass (binding.rs): a figure-eight control loop is detected by the segment-orientation predicate and refuses the typed `trim_clip_failed` case (class `Refused`, payload `case = trim_clip_failed`) — Inconclusive, never a silent approximation.
tests_required.full_extrude_without_trim_answers_bit_id: pass (binding.rs): the no-trim row's value is bit-identical (`to_bits`) to `bd_bridge::tree_facts` on the equivalent `SolidSpec::Prism`; the bracket is degenerate, no crossings, zero retained arcs.

smoke.verdict: All four rows reach the constructor through the flipped door idiom and refuse TYPED naming the open carrier class (`non_canonical_carrier`); no untyped failure occurred, and no retry loop fired. The precise `trim_clip_failed` kind is asserted at the binding test level; the executor's `truck_base` refusal vocabulary carries the typed envelope case the door re-marshals.

stop_conditions: Neither stop condition fired. The corpus's actual idiom (a spline-bounded `bd.extrude` of a `plane * make_face(bd.Spline(...))`) maps cleanly onto the constructor's `trim_prism` input row (line profile + closed spline curve + net), so no SPEC_GAP was needed. No certified crossing was isolated at DEPTH_MAX on a corpus row: the corpus rows carry no recorded pullback net, so the constructor refuses `trim_pullback_missing` before paying for crossing isolation (never a retry loop).
deviations: The executor's typed refusal path: the constructor's precise `trim_clip_failed` Marshaled cannot cross `bd_bridge`'s `truck_base::evidence::Refusal` vocabulary (which has no `trim_clip_failed` case), so `trim_binding_error_to_refusal` maps it to the typed `UnsupportedEnvelope(NonCanonicalCarrier)` envelope the executor and door already re-marshal. The precise kind remains the constructor's contract and is asserted directly by `self_crossing_trim_loop_refuses_typed`.

The corpus rows typed-refuse rather than facts-match: the F1 authoring arm records the parametric periodic-spline carrier but no algebraic pullback net, so the ADM-003 bracket cannot be assembled. The packet's scope decision 3 explicitly admits a typed refusal as a valid recorded verdict; no recorded reference was edited and no OCC run was made.

A `MAX_TRIM_CONTROL_POINTS = 16` envelope guard was added to the constructor: the R9 clip's subdivision is exponential in the leaf degree, so a corpus spline recorded as one high-degree control loop refuses `trim_degree_out_of_envelope` typed rather than running an unbounded isolation. This keeps the packet's stop condition (record the verdict, never a retry loop) and does not touch the landed clip.
